newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-SAUBER STICK WITH FONTANA.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-SAUBER STICK WITH FONTANA.

text.p: Swiss Formula One team Sauber Petronas announced on Wednesday that Argentine Norberto Fontana would continue as their second driver for this weekend's German Grand Prix at Hockenheim.
Fontana, who retired in France and finished ninth in Britain, was promoted from team test driver when Italian Gianni Morbidelli broke his arm during testing before the French Grand Prix.
Sauber hope Morbidelli will return for the Hungarian Grand Prix on August 10.
